title: The Winter of the Bell House
author: Gideon Quintana
blurb: Wendell Joubert, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must finish the ritual the founders started before the well refills.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
